headline: Fresh Flurries at Stlican Shelf, Tempest and Oarbreaker
war_summary: Since the last edition, the hottest work has moved to the island and shelf fronts. Stlican Shelf shows three strategic-base events in the past two hours and eight in the past day, with The Old Mourn and Vulpine Watch touched most often. Tempest Island follows with three fresh events, Surge Gate and Isle of Psyche prominent, and Oarbreaker adds two more, including Fort Fogwood. Lykos Isle has dropped out of the two-hour ledger but remains active in the six-hour totals, with nine events at Fort Guile, Marudia, and The Squall. Fishermans Row, which carried the heaviest load of the day with thirty-four events, has gone quiet in the latest two hours. Weathered Expanse likewise shows no new flips, yet its daily casualties remain immense, exceeding twenty-two thousand Warden and nineteen thousand Colonial losses. Farranac Coast has quieted, and DeadLands has not added to its Salt March flurry since earlier. The war, now in its 125th day, still runs without a declared victor.
